_comment: Stdio transport example. The g8e binary runs as a subprocess MCP server that proxies all requests to the running gateway over mTLS with a bound CLI session. Every tool call passes through the full L1-L5 governance pipeline. A running gateway is required. Exposes all 30 native tools. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, VS Code, Continue, Aider, Goose, Gemini, and other MCP-compatible clients. Use 'g8e mcp agent show <agent>' to generate agent-specific configs, or 'g8e mcp agent run <agent>' to launch with governance automatically. The canonical schema is defined in internal/services/mcp/config.go (SimpleConfig).
